Hello, Mr. Thornton.
I'm calling to confirm your dental appointment with Dr. O'Rourke tomorrow at 3.
30.
Oh, yes.
Sorry, but I can't make it.
My boss scheduled a meeting tomorrow afternoon, and I forgot to cancel my appointment with Dr. O'Rourke.
When's the earliest I can reschedule?
Well, we don't have any appointments available until next month.
But I can make a note to call you if we have any cancellations before then.
That's OK.
Next month is fine.
Just let me check my calendar before we make the appointment.

30。
哦，是的。
抱歉，但我去不了了。
我的老板安排了明天的会议，我忘记取消和奥罗克医生的预约了。
我最早什么时候可以改期？
嗯，我们直到下个月都没有空档的预约了。
不过我可以记下来，如果在此之前有任何取消，我会给您打电话。
没关系。
下个月可以。
让我先查一下我的日程表再安排预约。
